findings.summary: fillna("unknown") raises TypeError if customers["region"] is categorical, since "unknown" isn't a listed category; cast to object first.
Customers with a null region are also labeled "unknown", which contradicts the docstring saying "unknown" covers only customers missing from customers.
("order_id", "count") skips null order_id values; use "size" if every row should be counted.
Sort uses the default non-stable quicksort, so regions with equal revenue may come out in varying order; pass kind="stable".
